description: Interface definition for the Narrative Engine
purpose: Transforms cosmic patterns into player-specific narrative, manages narrative memory, and drives myth/prophecy formation

inputs.name: detected_patterns
inputs.description: Cosmic patterns from the ASH Pattern Engine

inputs.name: player_state
inputs.description: Current player state including attunement and alignment

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: narrative_events
outputs.description: Generated narrative events for the player

outputs.name: player_memory_update
outputs.description: Updates to the player's narrative memory

outputs.name: npc_manifest
outputs.description: NPCManifest emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: worldstate_delta_packet
outputs.description: WorldstateDeltaPacket emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: faction_topology_state
outputs.description: FactionTopologyState emitted under ASH generation contract.

methods.name: interpret_pattern
methods.description: Transform a cosmic pattern into a player-specific narrative interpretation

methods.name: record_consequence
methods.description: Record a narrative consequence in player memory

methods.name: get_player_memory
methods.description: Retrieve the full narrative memory for a player

methods.name: evaluate_myth_eligibility
methods.description: Determine if a narrative event qualifies for myth formation

methods.name: synthesize_npc_manifest
methods.description: Build an NPCManifest from ASH provenance without authoring cosmological truth.

methods.name: emit_worldstate_delta_packet
methods.description: Return a WorldstateDeltaPacket and FutureGenerationBiasUpdate or DiagnosticNoOp.

invariants: All narrative generation derives from ASH patterns
Player narrative memory persists across sessions
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
